verdict.rationale: Evidence strongly documents Bevy's data-oriented ECS (components as plain structs, systems as functions) as a core architecture, which is one pillar of the story. However there is no evidence of a real profiler, explicit job/parallel scheduling system, or GPU instancing support for scaling heavy scenes. missing for 10: built-in or integrated profiler (e.g. tracing/Tracy support), documentation of parallel job execution across systems, and instancing for heavy scene rendering.
